sentences.text:
Mr. A. D. Kamkhedkar, App for the Respondent - State in Cr
 Revision Application No.355 of 2022.

Mr. S. R. Agarkar, App for the Respondent - State in Crimi
 Application No.356 of 2022.

Coram : Prakash D. Na
 Date : 22nd June, 20
 Per Court:
1.
In both these applications the applicants are prosecuted for the offence under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
The trial Court has issued process.

The main ground in this application is that there is no specific averments in the complaint invoking vicarious liability of applicant Nos.1 to 7 except stating that the applicant Nos. 1 to 7 are directors.
No role has been ascribed to the said applicants.

sentences.text: Learned APP submits that the concerned officer from the Food and Drugs Administration is not present although notice was issued to Respondent No.2.
Learned counsel for Applicants submits that the next date before the trial Court is tomorrow i.e. 23 rd June, 2022.
There shall be stay to the proceedings before the trial Court qua applicant Nos. 1 to 7 till next date.
